narrative.overview:
The operator chose the Issued Drawing world on 6 November 2026. Each concept is drawn like an engineering drawing. A title block beside the concept states who generated it, who checked it, the current check and the review date. The page is a pale grey field with a faint grid.

The app is a tool. People read, check and copy knowledge in it every day. Density is high and decoration is low. Hairlines divide content. Corners are square. One blue marks what a person can act on. Colour also marks trust, and the trust word always says the same thing as text.

The tokens live in `apps/web/src/styles/`. This file records them. When the two differ, the stylesheets win and this file is out of date.
keyCharacteristics: A faint 32px grid on the page, kept off the reading column.
Square corners on every object except the spinner, the radio and the avatar.
Trust as a pale tint and a dark word, never colour alone.
Geist for words, Geist Mono for references, sources and dates in the title block.
Text selection, scrollbars and link underlines take their colours from the tokens.

rules.name: The one blue rule
rules.body: Ink blue marks only links, focus and the primary action. A fill that is not an action uses ink or grey.

rules.name: The word first rule
rules.body: A trust colour only tints a tag or a cell whose word already states the trust. Colour never carries trust alone.

rules.name: The measure rule
rules.body: Running text stops at about 75 characters. Use `--measure-reading` (34em). In Geist one `ch` is 0.67em wide, and `65ch` holds about 95 characters.

rules.name: The label rule
rules.body: Uppercase is only for the label of a title block cell or a menu group. A heading is never uppercase, and nothing sits above a heading as a label.

rules.name: The flat sheet rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page itself casts a shadow. A card, a title block or a table is a hairline box on the sheet.

dos: **Do** write each trust state as its word, from the closed set in `PRODUCT.md`.
**Do** keep ink blue for links, focus and the primary action.
**Do** set references, source numbers and dates in Geist Mono.
**Do** take every value from the tokens in `apps/web/src/styles/`.
donts: **Don't** round a corner other than the spinner, the radio or the avatar.
**Don't** cast a shadow from an object that sits on the page.
**Don't** let colour carry trust without its word.
**Don't** put a small uppercase label above a heading.
**Don't** add an animation beyond the four in `keyframes.css`.
